items.claim: USWDS describes itself as a design system for accessible, mobile-friendly government websites and includes components, patterns, design tokens, and utilities.
USWDS design principles emphasize starting with real user needs, earning trust, embracing accessibility, and providing continuity across experiences.
USWDS patterns support common multi-step service tasks and encourage clear next actions and responsive behavior.
The transferable quality is service continuity across many agencies and contexts, not a federal visual skin made from red, white, and blue.
